cases.prompt: Create an SDD for migrating a React Native feature flag system without changing runtime behavior.
expect: Defines problem, scope, decisions, and unchanged behavior
Includes phased rollout, rollback, verification, and risks
Stores design intent without implementing it

cases.prompt: Review an SDD that describes components and data types but omits rollout, rollback, observability, and open questions.
expect: Adds measurable acceptance and verification criteria
Preserves unresolved decisions as explicit open questions
